# Number Guessing Game

A simple text-based game where the user has to guess a randomly generated number between 1 and 100.

## Gameplay

- Game title: Number Guessing Game
- Game objective: Guess the randomly generated number between 1 and 100
- Gameplay:
  - Display game title and instructions
  - Prompt user for input (number between 1 and 100)
  - Check if the input is a valid number
  - Provide feedback on whether the guess is higher or lower than the target number
  - Keep track of the number of attempts made by the user
  - Continue to prompt the user for input until they correctly guess the target number or reach a maximum number of attempts
  - Display the number of attempts made by the user at the end of the game
